mechanism: Probenecid inhibits renal tubular secretion of indomethacin, increasing indomethacin plasma concentrations and risk of toxicity while also reducing probenecid's uricosuric efficacy.
action: Monitor for indomethacin toxicity including GI bleeding, renal impairment, and headache; consider alternative NSAID or adjust indomethacin dose; monitor uric acid levels as probenecid efficacy may be reduced.
